title: The Plant Water Claimed and Forgotten
youtube_title: The Plant Water Claimed and Forgotten | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Kavi is tangled up with a plant you claimed to have watered and almost hides it. Kavi tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
